description:
Command-line document processing: PDF, DOCX, images, email, hashing, PII detection, readability and ZIP inspection. Installs the `fileapi` command.

IMPORTANT LICENSING NOTE: this tool includes PDF support via Aelena.FileApi.Core.Pdf, which depends on iText 7 under the AGPL, so the tool as a whole is AGPL. The library without PDF, Aelena.FileApi.Core, is MIT.
title: FileApi CLI
